stories.title: Hari pertama di Kuala Lumpur
stories.text:
Rahim tiba di Kuala Lumpur pada waktu pagi.
Dia naik teksi ke ___ (1).
Di bilik dia minum ___ (2).
Kemudian dia telefon ___ (3).
stories.en: Rahim reaches Kuala Lumpur in the morning. He goes by taxi to the hotel. In the room he drinks a tea. Then he calls his family.

stories.title: Beli-belah di pasar
stories.text:
Sara pergi ___ (1) pada hari Ahad.
Dia beli roti, susu dan ___ (2).
Dia bayar dengan ___ (3).
stories.en: Sara goes shopping on Sunday. She buys bread, milk and apples. She pays by card.

stories.title: Pasport hilang
stories.text:
Ahmad mencari ___ (1) dia.
Dia minta tolong daripada seorang ___ (2).
Nasib baik, ia ada di dalam ___ (3).
stories.en: Ahmad is looking for his passport. He asks a policeman for help. Luckily it is in his bag.

stories.title: Di klinik
stories.text:
Bilal rasa ___ (1).
Dia pergi jumpa ___ (2).
Doktor beri ubat dan ___ (3).
stories.en: Bilal is unwell. He goes to the doctor. The doctor gives him medicine and rest.

stories.title: Kelas Melayu
stories.text:
Nadia belajar ___ (1) selama tiga bulan.
Dia berlatih setiap petang dengan ___ (2).
___ (3) dia kata dia sudah pandai.
stories.en: Nadia has been learning Malay for three months. She practises every evening with books. Her teacher says she already speaks well.

stories.title: Makan malam keluarga
stories.text:
Pada hari Ahad seluruh ___ (1) datang.
Nenek memasak ___ (2).
Semua makan bersama dan banyak ___ (3).
stories.en: On Sunday the whole family comes. The grandmother cooks rice. Everyone eats together and laughs a lot.

stories.title: Di stesen
stories.text:
Kereta api ___ (1) sepuluh minit.
Hassan membeli ___ (2) di kedai.
Kemudian dia naik ___ (3).
stories.en: The train is ten minutes late. Hassan buys a newspaper. Then he gets on the train.

stories.title: Petang sejuk
stories.text:
Pada bulan Januari sangat ___ (1).
Aisha memakai ___ (2) yang hangat.
Dia minum ___ (3) panas dan membaca.
stories.en: In January it is very cold. Aisha wears a warm coat. She drinks hot tea and reads.

stories.title: Makan malam di hotel
stories.text:
Pelayan membawa ___ (1).
Omar pesan ikan dan ___ (2).
Akhir sekali dia minta ___ (3).
stories.en: The waiter brings the menu. Omar orders fish and rice. At the end he asks for the bill.

stories.title: Kawan baharu
stories.text:
Lena dan Sana berjumpa di ___ (1).
Mereka bercakap tentang muzik dan ___ (2).
Akhir sekali mereka bertukar ___ (3).
stories.en: Lena and Sana meet in the park. They talk about music and travel. At the end they exchange their numbers.
